AbortAll.description: Optional: limit to one site. Default: every active run.

config.description: Admin intent (no secrets). The manager compiles it with wiring into the rendered config.

facts.description: From status reports: TLS fingerprint, listen address, health facts.

rendered_config.description: Read-only config as last compiled for the host (never contains creds).

DashboardTls.description: Dashboard TLS state (05-manager.md section 8). Write-only: the key (and the PEM) is never returned; `cert` is parsed from the stored leaf certificate.

sha256.description: Upper-case colon-separated SHA-256 of the leaf certificate DER (the dashboard's `tls_fingerprint_sha256`).

oneOf.description: Delete any provided pair; the agent generates a self-signed certificate.

cert_pem.description: PEM certificate (leaf first, at most 5 certificates). Must be a parsable X.509, not expired.

key_pem.description: Unencrypted PKCS#8 / PKCS#1 RSA / SEC1 EC PEM whose public key matches the leaf certificate.

DashboardUser.description: The password hash is never returned.

hash.description: Computed in the browser (WebCrypto). Plaintext passwords never reach the manager.

DrillDryRun.description: Read-only validation of target, allowlist, permissions and API reachability. Nothing is created.

DrillExpectation.description: What should happen (e.g. DNS fails within 30 s with where=dns_path).

DrillStart.description: Optional scheduled start, at least 2 minutes ahead. Omit to start now.

command.description: The one-liner for the target host, e.g. `curl -fsSL https://<manager>/install.sh | sudo bash -s -- expe_...` (the token is the positional argument of install.sh and is never placed in a process's argv by the agent itself).

token.description: Shown once; only sha256 is stored.

anyOf.description: Opaque cursor; null when there are no more pages.

components_by_type_health.description: Map component type -> counts by health.

FleetThresholds.description: Defaults from 05-manager.md section 14; any key may be omitted to keep its default.

allowlist.description: Drill target allowlist (owner-managed), e.g. `{nePk, interfaces[], vrrp_groups[]}`.

config.description: Non-secret settings (URL / api_base, optional CA bundle name).

credentials.description: Write-only. Omit to keep the stored secret.

series.description: Map key -> points for `rx_pps tx_pps rx_bps tx_bps errors drops` (`errors` = rx + tx errors and `drops` = rx + tx drops per status report, averaged per bucket). 5-minute buckets only, kept 48 h; `max` is always null; every `t` is epoch SECONDS; buckets without samples are absent.

component_type.description: Type of the component the issue is about (null for host-level issues and for issues that predate the field and whose component is gone). Stored with the issue, so it survives deletion of the component (CR-wp5-fleet-api-gaps item 6).

MasterKeyStatus.description: CR-m3-master-key-rotation. 503 `unavailable` when the key ring is misconfigured.

current_key_id.description: Id of `EXP_MASTER_KEY` (first 16 hex of sha256("exp-key-id/v1|" + key)); not secret.

previous_key_id.description: Id of `EXP_MASTER_KEY_PREVIOUS`, or null when no rotation is in progress.

remaining_previous.description: Values still sealed by the previous key (or unstamped legacy rows), all kinds together.

safe_to_remove_previous.description: True when remaining_previous and unknown_key_rows are both 0.

unknown_key_rows.description: Values stamped with a key id that is neither current nor previous (unreadable; fail closed).

MetricPoint.description: avg = sum/samples. Buckets with no samples are absent (drawn as gaps).

series.description: Map metric key -> points. Ranges 1h/6h/24h read 5-minute buckets; 7d/30d read 1-hour buckets. Every `t` is epoch SECONDS. Host keys are `cpu_pct mem_pct disk_pct load1 net_rx_pps net_tx_pps net_rx_bps net_tx_bps net_errors net_drops disk_write_kbps` (`net_*` come from the management interface and carry a null max). Component keys are the chartable keys of 05-manager.md section 13; probe components also accept `by_test_<name>` for each test of the catalog (01-contracts.md section 3), the per-test measurements per minute (CR-wp5-fleet-api-gaps item 5). `by_test_*` keys are only returned when asked for in `keys`.

token.description: Shown once; only sha256 is stored.

versions.description: Map of release version to number of hosts running it.

PlatformWebhook.description: Fires on `crit` open and on resolve. The URL is a secret and is never returned.

PlatformWebhookPut.description: `url` is write-only; omit to keep the stored value.

PortsPut.description: Replaces the probe's port assignments. The host's management interface (default-route / `in_use_by: mgmt`) is refused with `mgmt_interface_refused`; every `iface` must exist in the host facts.

reported_at.description: When the collector last reported the rows; null when none are held (not a collector, no report yet, or a collector version that does not report `probes[]`).

ReleaseImport.description: Import from GitHub Releases of `RELEASES_REPO`. The Ed25519 signature is verified over the exact manifest bytes and every artifact sha256 is checked; any mismatch records nothing (`signature_invalid`, `artifact_hash_mismatch`).

signature.description: Binary or base64 detached Ed25519 signature file.

RotateResult.description: New plaintext tokens are delivered to consumers through desired state only, never in this response. The previous value stays valid for 10 minutes.

SecretState.description: Write-only secret marker. The value is never returned.

admins.description: Upserts (invite by email + role, or disable). Owner only.

Shape.description: Host shape badge: P, C, D, R.

SiteRelease.description: Set the target release for a site. The canary host (if any) compiles first and is promoted after 10 healthy minutes. Rollback = set a previous version.

SpeedtestLogo.description: The stored logo artifact (set as branding.logo_artifact and delivered via the desired state's assets[]).

SpeedtestQr.description: Signage data: one URL per zone, `http(s)://<hostname>/?z=<zone>`. The UI renders the QR codes (no server-side image).

SpeedtestSettings.description: Manager speedtest settings of a site (12 section 8): compiled into the speedtest, collector and runner configs of the all-in-one host. Connectors (Mist, EdgeConnect) use the existing integrations endpoints; HPE Aruba SSE has no API connector (CR-m6-spec-resolutions).

text.description: Consent text. The manager increments `version` whenever the text changes (old tests keep the version they saw).

version.description: Read-only: assigned by the manager; ignored on write.

device_key.description: Whether the per-org device_key secret exists (write-only; never returned).

SpeedtestSettingsPut.description: Replace the settings. Unknown keys are rejected; `serve.listen_ip` must be an interface address of the speedtest host.

text.description: Consent text. The manager increments `version` whenever the text changes (old tests keep the version they saw).

version.description: Read-only: assigned by the manager; ignored on write.

SsoForm.description: Self-contained HTML document with an auto-submitting form that POSTs `token` (the SSO handoff JWT) to `https://<dashboard>/auth/sso`. The token is never placed in a URL.

WebhookRead.description: Webhook URL is a secret and is never returned.

url.description: Write-only. Omit to keep the stored value.
